svg.title: Harbor Goods AWS landing zone: organization, guardrails, logs and access
svg.desc: A management account and five member accounts in Security, Infrastructure and Workloads OUs. Service control policies deny risky calls such as stopping CloudTrail or using unapproved regions. The organization trail and AWS Config snapshots land in the KMS-encrypted log-archive bucket, and GuardDuty and Security Hub findings reach the delegated security account. People sign in through IAM Identity Center; GitHub Actions assumes the pipeline role through OIDC from the production environment only.

g.text: Organization root · home us-east-1 · recovery us-west-2
deny leave org · deny root user · protect security baseline · regions us-east-1, us-west-2
One organization: five accounts in three OUs, in Terraform
SCPs deny risky calls in every member account
Trail and Config logs to log-archive, findings to security
People via Identity Center, CI via OIDC with no stored keys
